tools.input:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import re
root=Path('/workspace/product')
terms=re.compile(r'Quiet Return|Quiet Offer|QR7|Harbor|Anchor plan picker|annual card|returning mobile offer',re.I)
cohorts=Counter()
without_cohort=[]
for p in root.rglob('*.md'):
    t=p.read_text()
    if not terms.search(t): continue
    matches=re.findall(r'\\bcohort:\\s*(["'^'"\\n.;]+)|\\bcohort\\s+(["'^'"\\n.;]+)',t,re.I)
    if matches:
        for match in matches: cohorts[next(x for x in match if x)].strip() if False else None
        for match in matches: cohorts[next(x for x in match if x).strip()]+=1
    else: without_cohort.append(str(p.relative_to(root)))
print('Alias matches by explicitly labeled cohort:')
for key,value in cohorts.most_common(): print(value,key)
print('Alias-matching files without labeled cohort:',len(without_cohort))
for p in without_cohort: print(p)
PY"

ids=set(re.findall(r'record-[0-9a-f]{10}', t))
print('Source IDs not found in cited records:',sorted(i for i in ids if i not in source_text and not any(i in x for x in links)))
print('Opening:',t.splitlines()[2])
assert not missing
PY"
